versions.content: If transmission of Network Management PDUs has been started, the CanNm Message Cycle Timer expires and when CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to either FALSE or if set to TRUE and additionally the transmission of PN shutdown messages is inactive, then the CanNm module shall transmit a Network Management PDU by calling CanIf_Transmit.
